These records show continuing operations on those dates and do not establish a permanent cessation that would trigger assessment of the predicted consequences [e1, e2]. limitations: Operational notices do not establish comprehensive financial health or future survival [e1, e2].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: In one of two scenarios he lays out, if one or both of Anthropic and OpenAI die, half or more of the demand for AI compute and actual industry production will evaporate, along with Google, Amazon and Microsoft's further ability to feed themselves money.

statement.excerpt: One day, one or both of Anthropic and OpenAI die, which leads to half or more of the demand for AI compute and actual industry production evaporating, and any further ability for Google, Amazon and Microsoft to further feed themselves money.

demand for AI compute and actual industry production evaporating

our_interpretation: This is a conditional scenario, not a dated prediction that a lab must fail.
Die means permanently ceasing material AI operations, rather than a temporary outage, paused training, acquisition with continuing operations or loss of one customer.
Half or more applies to industry-wide AI compute demand and production relative to their pre-failure levels.
The final clause concerns the investment-to-cloud-purchase financing channel described in the surrounding passage.
No deadline or post-failure measurement window is supplied; neither is invented here.
criteria.support_condition: After a qualifying lab failure, comparable industry evidence shows that the failure caused at least a 50% decline in AI compute demand and production, together with cessation of the described financing channel.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a qualifying lab failure and completion of the resulting adjustment, comparable evidence shows that industry demand or production retains more than half its pre-failure level, or that the described financing channel continues.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Verified permanent cessation of material AI operations by at least one named lab, followed by comparable industry and financing records covering the completed adjustment. Support requires a causally linked decline of at least 50% in both compute demand and production, plus cessation of the described investment-to-cloud-purchase financing channel. Retention of more than half of demand or production, or continuation of that channel, would contradict the scenario. Measurements must account for migration to other suppliers.
